claims.text: After thyroidectomy for GD: start L-thyroxine @ a wt-based daily dose (1.6 µg/kg), less in elderly; TSH 6–8 wks post-op.
claims.quote: Following thyroidectomy for GD, L-thyroxine should be started at a daily dose appropriate for the patient's weight (0.8 lg/lb or 1.6 lg/kg), with elderly patients needing somewhat less, and serum TSH measured 6–8 weeks postoperatively.
claims.locator: Ross DS, et al. 2016 American Thyroid Association Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Hyperthyroidism and Other Causes of Thyrotoxicosis. Thyroid 2016;26(10):1343-1421
